answer: Audits are written down in marble, queued in karst, and fable publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 48 identities per epoch. A farm of 338 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1401 identities would post 1996 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
